_STALENESS_NOTICE.status: PARTIALLY STALE -- see per-key notes below before citing
_STALENESS_NOTICE.reason: Commit 96d0086 (and the trainer.py wiring immediately after it) fixed two defects that change what a TrustFedGNN/FTGD run actually computes: (1) BFWA's Frank-Wolfe loop previously made the fairness budget tau have ZERO effect on aggregation weights at any setting used anywhere in the repo; (2) the DP-active FTGD path now computes its released group means from a second, sensitive-attribute-blind forward pass (dp_statistic_s_blind, default True) instead of the same s-aware pass used for the task loss -- this changes the actual fairness gradient (and hence the trained model) for ANY run with model='trustfedgnn' (or FairSIN/FaVGNN), dp_enabled=True, dp_mode='ftgd'. A third, much smaller change (replacing a 1e-12 numerical guard with an explicit skip-and-count branch in the gradient-surgery projection) touches every run that takes the dp_mode='ftgd' code path at all, DP-enabled or not, by a ~1e-12-relative amount.

per_result_impact.material (re-run needed for a faithful n: any row/arm with model='trustfedgnn' (or FairSIN/FaVGNN) AND dp_enabled=True AND dp_mode='ftgd' (the published method's own default config) -- affected by BOTH the s-blind release change and the tolerance-branch change
per_result_impact.negligible (~1e-12 relative, from the to: any row/arm with dp_mode='ftgd' but EITHER dp_enabled=False (no noise, so the s-blind gate never fires) OR a non-s-dependent backbone (GCN/GAT/FairGNN) -- e.g. this file's 'ours-nofser' column
per_result_impact.unaffected: any row/arm that never reaches dp_mode='ftgd' at all (dp_mode resolves to 'none' when dp_enabled=False and dp_mode='auto', or the arm explicitly sets a different dp_mode/aggregator), and any aggregator other than 'bfwa'/'robust_bfwa' for the BFWA-specific fix
